user.title: Connect to Pushie
user.description: Use an All sending integration token (or SEND_TOKEN). Verification does not send a notification.

test.title: Send real test notification
test.description: Submitting sends to all subscribers of the selected topic. Zero inboxes means no subscribers; inboxes with zero queued devices means inbox-only delivery.

error.invalid_url: Enter an HTTPS origin without credentials, path, query or fragment.

error.unsupported_api: Update Pushie: topic API version 1 is required.
error.too_large: The notification exceeds the server size limit.
error.invalid_message: Enter a nonblank message (at most 2000 UTF-8 bytes) and title (at most 160 bytes).
error.no_topics: No topics found. Create topics in Pushie, then retry.

abort.already_configured: This Pushie installation is already configured.
